detail.title: Refined Metareasoning Mechanisms and Architecture Limitations
detail.summary: This revision synthesizes how cognitive architecture constraints and observational limitations (such as degeneracy in model parameters) restrict the detection of unrecognized reasoning limits, building upon a comparative analysis of cognitive architectures and rational agency.
detail.reason: Revising the project notebook to incorporate new evidence on observational degeneracy as a limitation for reasoning systems.
